hero.title: We build businesses that scale.
hero.subtitle: Content, brand, digital systems, talent, and government relations — one partner handling the operations behind your growth.

about.title: The team behind the parts of the business that don't run themselves.
about.body: We're a multidisciplinary team of strategists, designers, developers, and operations specialists who handle the work that keeps a business moving — content, brand, systems, hiring, and paperwork with government platforms. Clients come to us because it's easier to have one accountable partner than six separate vendors.
about.point_1_body: Content, design, digital, HR, training, and tenders — under a single point of contact.
about.point_2_body: ERP, CRM, government portals — we implement the systems your team will actually use daily.
about.point_3_body: Vendor qualification, tender documentation, and government dues — tracked so nothing slips.

services.title: Six services, one accountable team.
services.s1_body: Content strategy, marketing messaging, campaign content, and project storytelling that gets read.
services.s2_body: Websites, online stores, ERP and CRM systems, and high-converting smart landing pages.
services.s3_body: Visual identity, social content design, digital and print ads, and corporate collateral.
services.s4_body: Government platform training, sales and customer service coaching, and digital marketing upskilling.
services.s5_body: Recruitment, hiring support, HR operations, and government platform and certificate management.
services.s6_body: Vendor qualification, tender tracking, proposal preparation, and government dues recovery.
